text:
mira_cs: Hey team — sketching an "enablement docket" to hand customers at kickoff. Goal: concise guidance on prefetching, batching, and streaming that non-engineers can share with their SDK teams. Thoughts?

sam_ops: love this. short checklist + 1 pager sounds ideal. include a quick 'what to expect' for latency/cost tradeoffs. :thumbsup:

jordan_pm: +1. also add a one-line renewal-risk signal so CS knows when to escalate (e.g., sustained >20% error rate or 3 days of cold-start failures).

lex_engineer: Will add a tiny code snippet for prefetch + TTL and a sample batching config. Keep examples in both REST and JS SDKs.

mira_cs: good call. Draft outline I'm thinking: 1) Quick WHY (user impact) 2) Prefetch pattern + snippet 3) Client-side batching advice 4) Streaming best-practices 5) Fallthroughs & upgrade paths 6) Signals we monitor for renewals 7) How to contact support / playbook links

sam_ops: For prefetch snippet, show both optimistic prefetch (background warm) and strict prefill (blocking). Example: `POST /v1/prefetch {"tenant_id": "T123", "templates": [...]}`. Keep it pseudo so PMs can paste into decks.

lex_engineer: Example JS snippet (short):
```
// prefetch example
await client.prefetch({ tenantId: 'T123', keys: ['welcome_prompt'], ttl: 600 });
// client-side batching hint
client.batchConfig = {maxBatchMs: 25, maxBatchTokens: 2048};
```
Make sure to call out tradeoffs: higher maxBatchMs -> better cost, worse tail latency.

mira_cs: Nice. For streaming: recommend cutting up responses for UI progressively, advise clients to keep socket idle timeouts >= 30s, and include example fallback to polled results if streaming disconnects.

jordan_pm: Can we add a mini troubleshooting flow for customers: "slow responses" -> check client batch window, check prefetch TTL, check sticky routing to dedicated pool. Include links to Console traces.

onboarding-bot: New trial started: tenant T-ACME-402 at 1725555570

sam_ops: Also include quick checklist for enablement sessions: 1) confirm model & quantization settings 2) validate prefix cache keys 3) run a 30-minute warmup with parallel workers 4) capture baseline traces

mira_cs: Perfect. I'll assemble a 1-pager and a one-slide checklist. Lex/Jordan — can you review by EOD tomorrow? If ok I'll push to the customer resources page and attach to kickoff invite templates.

lex_engineer: Yep — will review. Adding a short note on safe defaults for batchConfig so customers don't accidentally set huge batches.

jordan_pm: Reviewing tomorrow morning. One ask: add a tiny blurb for legal/compliance teams about PII in prefetch keys (avoid storing raw user PII).

mira_cs: Good catch — will add. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
